crossRefs.note: But they didn’t listen or turn their ear, but walked in their own counsels and in the stubbornness of their evil heart…
but they mocked the messengers of God, and despised his words, and scoffed at his prophets, until Yahweh’s wrath arose…
But my people didn’t listen to my voice. Israel desired none of me.
Because I knew that you are obstinate, and your neck is an iron sinew, and your brow bronze;
Oh that you had listened to my commandments! Then your peace would have been like a river and your righteousness like…
But they refused to listen, and turned their backs, and stopped their ears, that they might not hear.
Yes, they made their hearts as hard as flint, lest they might hear the law, and the words which Yahweh of Armies had…
I gave her time to repent, but she refuses to repent of her sexual immorality.
Behold, I will throw her into a bed, and those who commit adultery with her into great oppression, unless they repent…
But we will certainly perform every word that has gone out of our mouth, to burn incense to the queen of the sky, and…
The houses of Jerusalem, and the houses of the kings of Judah, which are defiled, will be as the place of Topheth, even…

translations.web: But they didn’t listen and didn’t incline their ear. They didn’t turn from their wickedness, to stop burning incense to other gods.
translations.bsb: But they did not listen or incline their ears; they did not turn from their wickedness or stop burning incense to other gods.
translations.kjv: But they hearkened not, nor inclined their ear to turn from their wickedness, to burn no incense unto other gods.
translations.asv: But they hearkened not, nor inclined their ear to turn from their wickedness, to burn no incense unto other gods.
